note: Healthy JSON with ASCII keys and Chinese values. Because the keys are Latin letters the whole response measures a non-spaced ratio of 0.378, so TAIL_LOOP dispatches it to WORD mode -- this fixture never exercises character mode, and nothing about char-mode behaviour can be argued from it. See json-zh-keys-valid for the char-mode case. What it does cover: mixed-script structured output staying under every word-mode threshold, and a reminder that ASCII scaffolding alone can hold a mostly-Chinese payload in word mode.
